name: p6_lem23_eq8
statement: (k n : ℤ) : p6_kfib k (n - 1) * p6_kfib k (n + 1) - p6_kfib k n ^ 2 = ((Int.negOnePow n : ℤˣ) : ℤ)
closed: ∀ (k n : ℤ), p6_kfib k (n - 1) * p6_kfib k (n + 1) - p6_kfib k n ^ 2 = ((Int.negOnePow n : ℤˣ) : ℤ)
informal: Lemma 2.3 (8) Cassini: f_{n-1} f_{n+1} - f_n^2 = (-1)^n [(-1)^n for integer n is Mathlib's Int.negOnePow.]
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n - 1) * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n + 1) - Mathlib2.p6_kfib k n ^ 2 = ↑n.negOnePow
